voice.name: Nicolas Estrem - Mature
voice.why: A warm Southern French voice for the market trader on the Saint-Philippe square, the last stop of the first hour (apples, juice, sell). Not used by any other NPC. The game has male bodies only; the voice is male.

what.text: I buy at this stall. Bring me apple juice, fruit, cabbage or honey and I pay cash, the price on the board.

where.text: The orchard is a short drive out of Saint-Philippe. Pick the apples, press them into juice. Juice pays best here.

rumour.text: The price of apples went up this week. Somebody is hoarding them, I think.

bye.text: Come back when you have more.
